items.quote: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
items.claim: In verse 50:24, Joseph tells his brothers on his deathbed that God will visit them and bring them out of 'this land' to the land God swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
items.action: said unto his brethren (deathbed declaration / prophecy)
items.object: his brethren; the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob
items.mechanism: divine promise: God will visit and bring them out of this land
items.place: 'this land' (not named in the text; reading it as Egypt and the verse as Genesis 50:24 KJV comes from model-prior and is unverified)
